title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Towing Tariff: Tow-In Rates by Estimate Type
content:
Whether the network arranges a tow of a non-drivable vehicle to the center for a Repair Estimates & Appointments estimate, and the tow figures of each estimate type, are as follows.

| Estimate type | Network-arranged tow-in | Free radius (miles) | Rate per mile beyond the free radius | Hook-up charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | No | 0 | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Drive-In Estimate | No | 0 | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Scheduled Estimate | No | 0 | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Mobile Estimate | No | 0 | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | Yes | 25 | 4.25 USD | 95.00 USD |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | Yes | 35 | 4.25 USD | 95.00 USD |

- **Free radius** — the tow distance covered without a mileage charge.
- **Rate per mile** — the charge per tow mile beyond the free radius.
- **Hook-up charge** — the flat hook-up charge for an arranged tow.

- **Network-arranged tow-in** — whether the network arranges a tow of a non-drivable vehicle to the center for the estimate.

Only the Blueprint Teardown Estimate (25-mile free radius) and the Structural Blueprint Estimate (35-mile free radius) arrange a tow-in; both charge 4.25 USD per mile beyond the free radius and a 95.00 USD hook-up charge. On the other four types every figure is 0.
